reviews.text: So pleased with the treatment my dog got when he got groomed. Natalia is very professional in what she does and took great care of my dog. I will 100% be back.

I specifically asked Natasja not to cut my dog’s hair on his head (it was so long we braided it), to cut the long hair on his body and his legs to prevent being too wet from walks, and absolutely do not use clippers as he’s a spaniel and I don’t want to ruin his silky coat. She confirmed everything and said she’ll use scissors on him. I left her with a silky smooth soft cocker and I got back a rough and uneven coat, he had a bold shaved spot under his ear (must have been an accident as he has zero mats, he’s brushed daily – I’d understand if she told me but she didn’t!) and of course she cut the long hair on his head that I asked to leave but left the long hair I asked to cut. She only cut his front legs but not the hinds so the body shape just looks stupid. I feel like she completely ignored everything I said and just did what she’s used to. All I can do is pray that she didn’t permanently ruin his coat and it’ll grow back silky again. She also unnecessarily shaved his whiskers for some reason but only on one side! Never in his 3 years of grooming have I had these issues with our previous groomer.
